rag.text:
Test: TC-99005 — Feature flag off hides capability from navigation and API
Priority: High | Status: Reference | Type: Manual
Folder: /Neutral/Feature flags
Labels: neutral-golden, journey

Steps:
1. Disable target feature flag in staging
   Data: flag: example.feature.enabled = off
   Expected: Flag saved
2. Refresh application as standard user
   Expected: Capability menu entry is not shown
3. Enable flag and refresh
   Data: flag: on
   Expected: Capability entry appears
4. Smoke-check primary action once enabled
   Expected: Happy path loads without error
